question: Infrared optical ______ can be used for measuring and monitoring temperatures and hot spots of jet engine rotor blades.
solution:
The correct answer is __Pyrometer.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• A pyrometer__ is a sort of remote-sensing thermometer that measures the temperature of things that are far away.
 
• Pyrometers have appeared in many forms throughout history.
 
• It can be used for measuring and monitoring temperatures and hot spots of jet engine rotor blades.
 
• It is a device that determines the temperature of a surface from a distance based on the quantity of thermal radiation it produces, a process known as pyrometry and sometimes radiometry.
 
• The majority of pyrometers work by detecting radiation from the body being measured.
 
• It is founded on the idea that the intensity of light received by the observer is proportional to the distance between the observer and the distant source's temperature.
 
• A modern pyrometer consists of an optical system and a detector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• A hygrometer is a device that measures the amount of water vapour present in the air, soil, or restricted places.
 
• An ammeter is a device that measures the current flowing through a circuit.
 
• A Machmeter is a flight instrument in an aircraft's pitot-static system that displays the ratio of true airspeed to sound speed, a dimensionless quantity known as Mach number.
